mapper.select: INSERT INTO public.artifact_file ( commit_id, logical_path, bucket_name, file_key, content_type, device_id ) VALUES ( #{commitId}, #{logicalPath}, #{bucketName}, #{fileKey}, #{contentType}, #{deviceId} ) ON CONFLICT (commit_id, logical_path) DO UPDATE SET bucket_name = EXCLUDED.bucket_name, file_key = EXCLUDED.file_key, content_type = EXCLUDED.content_type, device_id = EXCLUDED.device_id RETURNING file_id, (created_at = updated_at) AS inserted
